questions.text: Which personal and institution details should the tenant enter besides the volume figures (e.g. contact person name, phone, email, hospital name, address, registration number)? Which of these are mandatory?
What time period do the volume figures (USGs, deliveries, caesareans, NICU, MTPs) cover: per month, per year, or something else? Are they self-declared estimates, with no verification?
What exactly does 'No. NICU things' mean: NICU admissions per period, number of NICU beds, or both?
Should 'No. of deliveries' include caesareans (with caesareans as a subset), or should it count only normal deliveries?

Where does this form sit in the blueprint's onboarding flow: during the initial application (with the government certificate upload), or after ratification alongside department selection? Can the tenant edit the figures later, or are they locked like departments?
Do these figures feed anything downstream, for example the 'Double Delivery Figure' / 'Original Delivery Averages' subscription model or Super Admin review? Or are they informational only?
